entry.title: New: Bill 194 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — On agenda 2025-02-18
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 25, ARTICLES 1, 2, 4, 5, AND 7, OF THE HAWAIʻI (2022-2024) COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO TELECOMMUNICATION ANTENNAS AND TOWERS

Amends the definition of “telecommunication antenna” and adds a definition for “telecommunication tower”, expands plan approval requirements, allows for telecommunication antennas or towers in any zoning district upon approval of the Planning Director, and revises siting, design, and operating regulations to align with State law.

Latest action: On agenda 2025-02-18
